note: Registered cell expectations for Study 014, locked-replication stratum (the reviewer-authored holdout stratum lives in harness/MATRIX-HOLDOUT.json and is never executed pre-freeze). Layers: owp = openworkproof.acceptance.verify_acceptance_bundle unchanged; binding = adapter Layer BINDING (adapter/SPEC.md section 5); replay = adapter Layer REPLAY. Expected values are the adjudicated layer OUTCOME strings and nothing else: 'pass', 'fail' (owp layer only - upstream reports bundle failure as one composite verdict), 'fail:<code>' where <code> is an exact registered code, or 'unavailable'. On the replay layer 'unavailable' is definitionally equivalent to the code replay-unavailable: the layer records verdict 'unavailable' with code 'replay-unavailable', and the outcome string for that pair is 'unavailable'. combined is derived: pass iff every layer outcome is pass. Per-cell schema: role in {endpoint, control-gate, demonstration, descriptive} - only endpoint rows count toward R1, control-gate rows are validity gates evaluated first, demonstration and descriptive rows are published but never counted. attackerCapability in {none, tamper, selective-keys, full-keys} - the capability the construction actually requires. registeredAbsences lists artifact names ('pack', 'facts', 'evidence', 'commitment', 'bundle', 'evaluation') whose absence the registry authorizes for that cell, independently of any expected verdict; an unregistered absence is NOT-ADJUDICATED on the validity channel. registeredUndetected: true marks cells whose all-pass outcome is itself the registered finding. variant 'tampered' = bytes changed after signing (signatures stale); 'resigned' = rebuilt validly with the study's fixture keys (insider) so the OWP chain stays cryptographically valid; 'artifact' = a retained artifact outside the signed chain edited or deleted.

cells.construction: untouched baseline chain and retained artifacts
cells.note: validity gate: must pass all three layers, evaluated before any endpoint row; a failure voids the attempt as inconclusive rather than falsifying R1

cells.construction: one byte of acceptance_receipt.signature flipped
cells.note: validity gate: proves the OWP verifier exercises signatures

cells.construction: one byte of a committed evidence payload changed
cells.note: validity gate: proves the OWP verifier re-hashes committed evidence

cells.construction: one parent id removed from a receipt's parent_receipt_ids without re-signing
cells.note: validity gate: proves receipt signatures cover the causal fields

cells.construction: executing receipt's request_arguments target path changed without re-signing
cells.note: validity gate: OWP refuses at model integrity (arguments_digest binding) before signatures are even checked; the signature is also stale

cells.construction: retained pack bytes edited after the decision (threshold 5000 -> 6000; baseline facts still approve)
cells.note: replay passes because the edited pack still approves these facts: only the byte commitment sees the drift. No key and no signed byte is touched - the retained artifact store alone is edited

cells.construction: retained pack replaced by a same-id pack at version 0.2.0 that still approves the baseline facts
cells.note: packVersion cross-check also diverges; digest is the operative catch

cells.construction: retained pack replaced by a different-id pack engineered to approve the baseline facts
cells.note: compatible-looking output does not survive the byte commitment

cells.construction: packDigest field edited inside WorkOrder.objective in the bundle, signatures untouched
cells.note: the Maintainer signature covers objective, so OWP fires; on the binding layer the edited objective is still canonical JCS of its own content, so the byte rule passes and the retained commitment document is what diverges - pack-digest-mismatch is reachable only in the resigned twin

cells.construction: full rebuild with a wrong packDigest in the commitment; chain validly signed
cells.note: only the adapter's recomputation against retained bytes can see this

cells.construction: retained pack bytes deleted from the artifact store
cells.note: verification-unavailable must fail closed, never read as a pass. The absence is registered here, independently of the expected verdict, so validity and detection stay separate channels

cells.construction: retained facts amount 250.00 -> 240.00 (disposition unchanged: approve)
cells.note: JPS digests no facts anywhere; this commitment is adapter-owned by necessity

cells.construction: whole facts document replaced (category -> personal; true evaluation now reject)
cells.note: both input commitment and outcome recomputation fire

cells.construction: whole facts document replaced by different facts whose evaluation yields the identical disposition
cells.note: the registered binding-not-outcome cell: outcome equality must not excuse input substitution

cells.construction: rebuild with factsDigest committing to a document that was never evaluated; retained facts are the originals
cells.note: commitment field vs retained bytes

cells.construction: facts produce reject; commitment honestly carries the reject disposition but declares an executable action, and the chain executes it
cells.note: OWP authorization (grants) is satisfied; only the judgment map is violated

cells.construction: evidence receipt absent -> unresolved with handoff requested; chain executes anyway under a bound commitment
cells.note: post-hoc twin of Study 013's I1: here the question is provability, not runtime behavior

cells.construction: facts outside applicability -> not-applicable with handoff requested; chain executes anyway
cells.note: covers the second requested-handoff shape

cells.construction: true evaluation is reject; commitment and retained envelope carry a forged approve disposition; action consistent with the forgery
cells.note: the replay-only cell: every retained artifact is internally consistent and the action map is satisfied, so only deterministic recomputation under the pinned tuple exposes the forgery. Since the totality rule made c14 fire on the binding layer too, this is the sole cell where replay is the unique detector

cells.construction: true disposition unresolved/[missing-required-evidence]; forged to unresolved/[unknown]; action null; no receipt carries the commitment digest, but the chain still publishes an owp.apply_patch execution
cells.note: re-registered under exact-set totality: a null action with an unmarked execution in the chain is now a binding violation, not a pass. Under the previous marker-selected rule this row read binding:pass, which is precisely the bypass round 1 found

cells.construction: facts amount 7500.00 -> outcome manual-review with handoff none; commitment honest, action null; the chain executes an owp.apply_patch that carries no commitment digest
cells.note: the totality cell: an honest non-executable disposition, an honest null action, and an execution that simply omits the marker. Marker-selected checking passed this; structural discovery over the action class does not. manual-review is the map's most defensible non-executable outcome - the pack requires an accountable human determination

cells.construction: executing receipt's tool_name edited to owp.repo_read without re-signing
cells.note: OWP refuses at model integrity (tool/arguments tagged union) before signatures are checked; on the binding layer the commitment digest is now carried by a receipt whose tool the map cannot authorize

cells.construction: rebuild binding the commitment digest to the repo_read request instead of apply_patch
cells.note: correct judgment attached to the wrong tool, validly signed

cells.construction: committed patch bytes swapped in the bundle without re-signing
cells.note: OWP owns committed-evidence integrity; the adapter never re-checks OWP evidence bytes

cells.construction: rebuild executing a canonical patch that actually creates decision-actions/disburse-other.json - the patch's own Git header, blob object id and hunk name that path, and the declared target_paths agree with it, because OWP's parser refuses any patch whose derived paths differ from its declared ones; commitment kept from the original authorization
cells.note: receipt arguments_digest no longer equals the committed one

cells.construction: amount inside the patch bytes 250.00 -> 2500.00 without re-signing
cells.note: patch_digest / evidence sha mismatch inside OWP

cells.construction: full rebuild executing amount 2500.00 through the upstream patch executor, validly signed end to end; commitment kept from the 250.00 authorization
cells.note: the headline cell: a cryptographically valid receipt chain, applied by OWP's own executor to a real candidate workspace, that no longer represents the judged action; without the adapter layer it would pass everything

cells.construction: the approved bound execution plus a second, unbound owp.apply_patch receipt carrying a different canonical patch, inserted post-hoc and re-signed with the Sidecar key alone (a live second patch round is not constructible at this commit: publication demands the ledger tip be a parent, causal replay demands the apply-patch parent set be exactly {grant issuance, latest prior repo_read}, and a second allow/succeeded apply-patch without an intervening needs_rework -> rollback -> retry episode is refused outright)
cells.note: the surplus arm of exact-set totality: one commitment authorizes one execution, so two action-class receipts is a violation whichever one carries the marker. The OWP-layer refusal is the registered expectation and the constructibility refusal is itself a protocol finding - OWP's own single-active-patch rule already bounds a work order to one execution, which is why this attack has to leave the live path

cells.construction: baseline receipts paired with a different validly-signed WorkOrder (different deadline, generic objective)
cells.note: work_order_digest binding in every receipt is the operative OWP catch

cells.construction: objective, retained artifacts and retained commitment are all consistently commitment X; the executing request's context_source_digest is instead the digest of a different valid commitment Z, and the whole chain is re-signed around it
cells.note: the execution-side arm: the authorization-time point is coherent, so the objective comparison passes and structural discovery still finds the action-class receipt - the divergence is at the request-level marker alone. This is what the second binding point sees that the first does not. The study registers two-point binding as defense-in-depth, not as demonstrated necessity: no ablation arm here shows OWP's own receipt-to-WorkOrder association is insufficient

cells.construction: the executing grant substituted post-hoc with a validly re-signed variant whose valid_from postdates the executed call's occurred_at, leaving the issuance receipt tied to the original grant
cells.note: generic upstream-corruption cell. It does NOT reach the grant-window replay refusal it is named for: upstream rejects grant identity/digest consistency against the issuance receipt first. The named mechanism is exercised directly instead by the upstream probe tests in harness/tests/test_upstream_probes.py. The live path refuses to construct an out-of-window publication at all (grant expiry is pinned to the work-order deadline and publication requires occurred_at == clock() <= deadline), which is itself a recorded protocol finding

cells.construction: alternative valid WorkOrder remint accepted: a fully consistent rebuild under a different, equally valid WorkOrder (laxer quota ceiling, different acceptance criteria), same commitment
cells.note: descriptive, excluded from R1 credit. OWP has no policy version ordering and the study has no external anchor, so an older or alternative WorkOrder is a different, equally valid contract. An attacker holding every key can remint the whole chain coherently; nothing chain-internal distinguishes the remint from the original. Published as a boundary, never counted as a detection or a miss

cells.construction: full rebuild whose commitment claims a different (syntactically valid) executableDigest and a matching different evaluatorRelease string; every other field and every artifact is honest
cells.note: the replay tuple's identity fields are binding inputs, not decoration: the harness refuses to replay under a binary that is not the recorded one. supportedExtensions is also passed through to the evaluator now, but its materiality is bounded by the pack - the baseline pack requires no extension, so a forged extension set changes no disposition here and no cell claims otherwise

cells.construction: the executing receipt's parent_receipt_ids mutated to name the wrong grant receipt and that receipt alone re-signed with the Sidecar key
cells.note: generic upstream-corruption cell. It does NOT reach the exact-parent-set refusal it is named for: re-signing one receipt leaves every downstream previous_receipt_digest stale, so prefix adjacency fails first. The named mechanism is exercised directly by the upstream probe tests. A fully published chain with a wrong parent set cannot exist - publication replays causality and refuses it - which is itself a recorded protocol finding

cells.construction: one mid-chain receipt deleted from the bundle
cells.note: sequence contiguity and prev-digest adjacency

cells.construction: an extra parent id inserted on the executing receipt and that receipt alone re-signed with the Sidecar key
cells.note: generic upstream-corruption cell, same shape and same caveat as f23: downstream adjacency fails before the exact-equality parent check is reached. The superset refusal is exercised directly by the upstream probe tests

cells.construction: one receipt substituted from an independently built second execution
cells.note: prev-digest chain and per-work-order binding

cells.construction: one committed evidence payload substituted from the second execution (same path)
cells.note: committed set must exactly match receipt refs, per-file sha checked

cells.construction: commitment carried only in the unsigned bundle metadata; objective generic; no receipt bound. Every retained artifact is present - the fixture lacks nothing, so no absence is registered
cells.note: disclosed designed demonstration, published but never counted toward R1: OWP verifies green while the judgment reference sits in a slot nothing checks - why the signed binding points exist
